researcher_notes:
COMPANY CONFIRMED REAL. Full legal name: Youibot Robotics Co., Ltd. (Shenzhen Youibot Robotics Co., Ltd.). Founded 2017 (mobile-robots.com vendor profile and Unchained Robotics brand page both state 2017; Tracxn states 2016 — minor discrepancy, 2017 is the more commonly published year). Operational HQ / R&D: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China (site contact phone 0755-89969989 = Shenzhen area code; second R&D centre in Xi'an). NOTE: the footer of en.youibot.com currently lists the 'Headquarters and registered office in the PRC' as 'Building 3, Northwest corner of Xianghe Road and Guanli Road intersection, Feidong Economic Development Zone, Feidong County, Hefei, Anhui Province, PRC' — i.e. the REGISTERED office moved to Hefei/Anhui while the company is still universally described as Shenzhen-based. Recommend country=China; city=Shenzhen with a note about the Hefei registered office. Headcount 501-1000 (Unchained Robotics), >500 employees with 65% in R&D (mobile-robots.com). Certifications claimed at company level: ISO, SEMI-S2, CE. Claimed presence in 30+ countries incl. Germany, Italy, Japan, Korea. EU route to market is via distributors/integrators — confirmed EU/DE distributor: Unchained Robotics (Paderborn, DE) lists 'Youibot L1000-R' at EUR 50,000 net; other resellers found: Eurobots (ES), Top3DShop, DKSH (APAC), RoboLodge. Japanese presence: jp.youibot.com + IPROS listings as 'Youibot Robotics Japan'.

PORTFOLIO SCOPE DECISION: Youibot builds ONLY autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). There are NO forklift-type AGVs (no mast, no forks, no stacking) and NO tugger/tow-train AGVs in the current catalogue. Every in-scope product is therefore product_type = 'Mobile AMR'. Load handling is either (a) under-ride jacking/lift-and-rotate (L series), (b) an open integration platform for customer top modules (P/B series), (c) roller/belt conveyor transfer (C series), or (d) an operator-assisted picking trolley (AT100).

EXCLUDED (deliberately, not force-fitted): ATS Series (ATS20, ATS12-FFU, ATS6) = semiconductor lot-box / SMIF POD / FOUP-FOSB transfer robots for fab cleanrooms — specific-load wafer-carrier handling, not warehouse pallet/load transport; O Series (OW12-300, OW8-350, OWC, OT12) = mobile manipulators with cobot arms for 12-inch wafer-carrier handling in fabs; ARIS-IDC = data-centre inspection robot (no load transport); YOUIFleet / YOUITMS = fleet-management and logistics-control SOFTWARE only.

DATA SOURCE QUALITY / METHOD: en.youibot.com serves product data on the CATEGORY pages (there are no per-product URLs; /products.html and the .xml sitemap are behind a WAF challenge, the /products-category/*.html pages are server-rendered and scrapeable via curl). The official category pages publish only a small spec card per model (payload, run time, L*W*H, navigation logic) plus prose. The 'Product Manual Download' PDFs on /download.html are gated behind a lead-capture form and could not be retrieved. Two FULL vendor-style parameter tables were found mirrored at distributor Eurobots (eurobots.net/youibot-l1000-en.html and /youibot-p200-en.html); these carry the complete Youibot datasheet layout (housing material, environment, floor condition, navigation, mobility, battery, safety) and are the source of the deeper specs for the L1000 and P200 entries. I did NOT propagate those environmental/battery-detail values to the other models even though they are almost certainly the same chassis platform — per project convention NULL beats a plausible-but-unconfirmed value. Where I did that, the note field says so explicitly.

KNOWN DATA CONFLICTS / TRAPS FOUND:
(1) L1000 exists in two generations. The legacy L1000 (still on the orphaned page en.youibot.com/product/lifting.html, on agvnetwork.com and on eurobots.net) is 1061*838*300 mm. The CURRENT catalogue model is 'L1000-CE' at 1152*770*300 mm. I used the current dimensions and flagged the rest. agvnetwork.com additionally lists '15kg Weight' for the L1000, which is obviously a data-entry error (the real chassis weight is 310 kg) — do not use agvnetwork for Youibot weights.
(2) Eurobots' 'YOUIBOT L500' page is internally contradictory (headline 500 kg, table says 'Max payload 300KG', 30 Ah battery = L300 electrics, but the main-body block is copy-pasted from the L1000). It is an unreliable, mixed record AND the L500 is no longer in the current catalogue. I excluded the L500 entirely.
(3) P200 run time: official current card says 8 h; Eurobots table says >=11 h; Top3DShop/other resellers say 10 h or 15 h. I used the official 8 h and flagged.
(4) AT100 dimensions: official EN card 650*550*1450 mm; IPROS Japan listing 640*630*1615 mm. Used the official figure.
(5) Max fleet size is quoted inconsistently across vintages: 100 (agvnetwork/eurobots), 200 (Unchained + current B-series text), 1000 (current L600 text, 'YOUI FLEET ... can seamlessly coordinate up to 1,000 AMRs'). I only recorded max_fleet_size where the CURRENT official page states it for that specific model.

FIELDS DELIBERATELY LEFT NULL EVERYWHERE:
vda5050_compatible — NO evidence of VDA 5050 support anywhere on youibot.com, in distributor material, or in trade press. Left NULL (not false); absence of a claim is not proof of absence.
functional_safety_level (PLd/PLe/SIL) — never published by Youibot.
fleet_control_architecture — Youibot repeatedly says 'distributed control system' / 'distributed intelligent scheduling system' for YOUIFleet. That is ambiguous marketing language (YOUIFleet is in practice a central fleet manager doing traffic control), so I refused to force it to 'Decentralized/Swarm'.
floor_flatness_req — the vendor tables state 'Min floor flatness FF25 (*ACI 117 Standard)'. None of the AP0 dropdown values (Standard (FM2) / High (FM1) / Very High (F-number) / None stated) maps honestly onto ACI-117 FF25, so NULL; raw value recorded here.
stop_accuracy convention — the L series is documented at +/-10 mm with SLAM only and +/-5 mm with SLAM+QR codes. I recorded the CONSERVATIVE 10 mm (infrastructure-free case), because 5 mm presupposes QR codes installed on the floor.
load_type convention — Youibot's own wording is generic ('trolleys, pallets, shelves, cabinets, carts'). No pallet standard (EUR/ISO) is ever named, so I used ['Custom Carrier'] only rather than guessing a pallet class that would drive a KO_SUBSET match.

products.notes: Official card: '300 kg Lifting Payload / 8 h Run Time / 780*550*300 mm Size / SLAM/QR Code Navigation Logic'. vehicle_length/width taken from the L*W*H string (300 mm is the chassis height, not a lift height). stop_accuracy=10: page states 'accuracy of +/-10mm using only SLAM navigation and +/-5mm when combining SLAM and QR navigation' — conservative value recorded. rotation_capable=true: 'Powerful Rotating Lifting Module ... lifting platform posture-follow function ... maintaining carrier orientation and posture'. autonomous_charging=true: 'the BMS battery control system enables real-time monitoring of the battery level and automatic charging when necessary'. infrastructure_free=true: SLAM primary nav, QR only as an optional accuracy aid. integration_capability from the L/P-series prose 'directly interfacing with enterprise MES/WMS information systems'. stacking_capability=false: jacking AMR with a low lift-and-rotate module, no mast — cannot stack. manual_usage=true: Youibot chassis spec tables list a 'Manual/Automatic Switch Button'. Battery is stated as 30 Ah but chemistry, voltage, charge time, speed, temperature, humidity, IP and gradient are NOT published for this model — the sister-model tables (L1000, P200) give LiFePO4 / 48 V / <=2 h / 1.5 m/s / 0-40 C / 10-90 %RH / IP20 and this is very probably the same platform, but those values are NOT confirmed for the L300-smart, so they are left NULL. lift_height (jacking stroke) not published for this model; the L1000 stroke is 60 mm.

Official card: '600 kg Lifting Payload / 8 h Run Time / 950*600*250 mm Size / SLAM/QR Code'. The headline feature is the 250 mm total chassis height ('industry-leading vehicle height of just 250 mm', '250 mm ultra-low vehicle height') and the compact 600 mm width — recorded as vehicle_width=600, vehicle_length=950; 250 mm is the chassis HEIGHT and there is no AP0 field for AMR overall height, so it is recorded here only. max_fleet_size=1000 from this model's own description: 'Integrated with Youibot's proprietary YOUI FLEET fleet management platform ... The system can seamlessly coordinate up to 1,000 AMRs'. stop_accuracy=10 from 'positioning accuracy of up to +/-10 mm using SLAM navigation and +/-5 mm when combining SLAM and QR codes'. infrastructure_free=true is explicitly supported: 'can be rapidly deployed in narrow aisles and low-clearance environments without requiring facility modifications'. rotation_capable=true is inherited from the L-series lift-and-rotate module — the L600 text does not restate it, so this one field is lower confidence than for the L300/L1000. lift_height (jacking stroke) NOT published for the L600 and it cannot simply be assumed equal to the L1000's 60 mm given the 250 mm ultra-low chassis — left NULL. No speed, battery chemistry, charge time, temperature, humidity, IP or gradient published for this model.

BEST-DOCUMENTED MODEL. Official current card: '1000 kg Lifting Payload / 8 h Run Time / 1152*770*300 mm / SLAM/QR Code' + 'It features a 48Ah battery and a rotary lifting module capable of lifting loads of up to 1000kg' + 'Fully compliant with CE certification and industry safety standards'. Deep specs from the full Youibot parameter table mirrored at https://www.eurobots.net/youibot-l1000-en.html (previous-generation L1000, 1060*838*300 mm chassis, same 48 Ah / 48 V electrics): max speed 1.5 m/s; maximum lift height 60 mm; ambient temperature 0 C-40 C without condensation; relative humidity 10-90 %; IP class IP20; cleanliness class max class 100; battery type Lithium Iron Phosphate 48 V 48 Ah; running time >=8 H; charging time <=2 H; charging mode Automatic / Manual / Quick Battery Replacement; maximum incline 2.5 deg; 2 x safety lidars installed diagonally; navigation mode 'Laser SLAM navigation, QR code (optional), 3D vision (optional)'.
DERIVATIONS AND CAVEATS: (a) DIMENSIONS are from the CURRENT L1000-CE (1152*770), NOT from the eurobots table (1060*838) — the chassis was redesigned; do not mix the two. (b) max_gradient=4.4 % is an exact trigonometric conversion of the published 'Maximum Incline 2.5 deg' (tan 2.5 deg = 4.37 %) — a unit conversion, not an estimate. (c) charge_time=120 min from '<=2H'. (d) lift_height=60 mm is corroborated independently by Unchained Robotics ('Jacking stroke is 60mm and can handle up to 1000kg', jacking speed 10 mm/s) — two independent sources agree, HIGH confidence on this single field. (e) cleanroom_class: vendor states 'Cleanliness class: Max class 100' (= ISO Class 5); the AP0 dropdown only offers 'None' / 'ISO 1–9', so 'ISO 1–9' is used to mean cleanroom-rated — raw value recorded here. (f) safety_standard=['ISO 3691-4'] is a MEDIUM-confidence read: the model's own name carries the '-CE' suffix and the page claims full CE compliance, which for a driverless industrial truck sold into the EU means EN ISO 3691-4 conformity — but Youibot does not print the standard number on this page (they DO print 'CE ISO 3691-4' explicitly for the AT100). Set NULL if the DB operator wants strict citation only. (g) omnidirectional_movement=false: the vendor table gives 'Turning diameter 1262 mm' and a rotation speed of '90 deg/1.21 s', i.e. a differential-drive chassis that must rotate; Youibot markets omnidirectional movement explicitly where it exists (P300, OW8-350, OWC). min_turning_radius left NULL because the 1262 mm figure belongs to the older 1060*838 chassis, not to the current 1152*770 CE chassis. (h) safety_coverage='Single plane (2D)': two safety laser lidars giving 360 deg planar coverage; 3D vision is listed only as an OPTION and is not described as safety-rated. (i) Unchained Robotics sells this model in the EU as 'Youibot L1000-R' at EUR 50,000 net — same machine, distributor naming; consider recording 'L1000-R' as an alias. (j) max_fleet_size deliberately NULL: sources conflict (100 / 200 / 1000) across vintages. (k) agvnetwork.com lists '34cm min. height of load for driving under' for the legacy L1000 — that is the required clearance UNDER the cart being picked up, which has no AP0 field (min_ground_clearance means something else), so it is noted here only.

Newest and heaviest L-series model; NOT indexed by any third-party source I could find (a web search for 'Youibot L1500' returns only L300/L500/L1000 material), so the ONLY source is Youibot's own current L-series category page. Card: '1500 kg Lifting Payload / 8 h Run Time / 1152*770*300 mm / SLAM/QR Code'. Prose: 'a heavy-duty AMR with an industry-leading payload of up to 1500 kg, designed for under-rack and cart transportation in manufacturing plants and warehouses'; '1500 kg capacity in a 770 mm-wide body for smooth operation in narrow aisles'; 'It features a 52Ah battery and a rotary lifting module capable of lifting loads of up to 1500kg'; '+/-10mm using only SLAM navigation and +/-5mm when combining SLAM and QR navigation'; 'Compact but powerful rotating lifting module ... simple and reliable pin design'. Shares the 1152*770*300 mm chassis with the L1000-CE. Battery capacity 52 Ah is published but chemistry/voltage/charge time are not; speed, gradient, temperature, humidity, IP and jacking stroke are NOT published for this model and are left NULL rather than copied from the L1000 table. PLAUSIBILITY CHECK: 1500 kg on a 1152 x 770 mm under-ride jacking chassis is at the top of, but well within, the credible range for this vehicle class — no red flag.

Open integration PLATFORM (no load handler of its own; 'support for more than 10 top modules and cobots'). Official current card: 'For Integration / 8 h Run Time / 1016*652*290 mm / I/O, Ethernet, WLAN, Power'. Deep specs from the full Youibot parameter table mirrored at https://www.eurobots.net/youibot-p200-en.html (variant 'P200-2', 1014*650*290 mm — within 2 mm of the current CE chassis): housing cold rolled steel; turning diameter 1124 mm; weight 180 kg; ambient temperature 0-40 without condensation; relative humidity 10-90 %; IP class IP20; cleanliness class max class 100; min floor flatness FF25 (ACI 117); navigation mode Laser SLAM; positioning precision +/-10 mm, angle precision +/-1 deg; max payload 200 KG; max speed 1.5 m/s; max speed of rotation 180 deg/s; traversal height 15 mm; traversal gap 30 mm; maximum incline 4 deg; driving wheel polyurethane dia. 150 mm; battery Lithium Iron Phosphate 48 V 60 Ah; charging mode Automatic / Manual / Quick Battery Replacement; 2 x safety laser lidars in the chassis; 2 x e-stops; 360 deg collision detection; WLAN IEEE 802.11 a/c.
DERIVATIONS AND CAVEATS: (a) max_gradient=7.0 % is the exact conversion of the published 'Maximum Incline 4 deg' (tan 4 deg = 6.99 %). (b) min_turning_radius=562 mm = half the published 1124 mm turning diameter (Top3DShop quotes 1130 mm for the same machine) — a straightforward derivation, flagged as such; note it is the swept-circle radius for rotating in place, not an Ackermann radius. Set NULL if the DB convention for this field is strictly Ackermann. (c) BATTERY RUNTIME CONFLICT: the official current P200-CE card says 8 h; the Eurobots table says '>=11H'; Top3DShop and other resellers quote 10 h standalone and 15 h. I recorded the OFFICIAL 8 h. charge_time=120 min is from the Eurobots table '<=2H'. (d) navigation_type includes QR/DM Code because Top3DShop and Youibot's own P-series marketing describe the P200 as using a 'laser/QR code navigation system'; the Eurobots table lists Laser SLAM only. (e) top_module_type from 'more than 10 top modules and cobots' plus the P/B-series prose 'rollers, belts, synchronous belt transfers, and backpack-style racks'. (f) safety_standard=['ISO 3691-4'] MEDIUM confidence, same reasoning as the L1000-CE: '-CE' product naming and 'CE certificate' shipped with the machine per Top3DShop, but the standard number is not printed on the Youibot page. (g) omnidirectional_movement=false: differential drive with a published turning diameter; Youibot introduces the P300 explicitly as 'an omnidirectional autonomous mobile robot', implying the P200 is not. (h) load_type left NULL — the P200 has no load handler; what it can carry depends entirely on the customer's top module.

Omnidirectional integration platform. Official card: 'For Integration / >=16 h Run Time / 1020*655*310 mm / I/O, Ethernet, WLAN, Power'. omnidirectional_movement=true is explicit and repeated: 'The P300 is an omnidirectional autonomous mobile robot built to optimize manufacturing logistics', 'Omni-Move Flexibility: Navigate freely in tight spaces', 'With omnidirectional mobility, the P300 delivers exceptional flexibility even in complex layouts and confined spaces'. battery_runtime=16 from '>=16 h'; a 90 Ah battery is stated ('long-lasting 90Ah battery-powered performance') but chemistry, voltage and charge time are not published. autonomous_charging=true and battery_swap_capable=true from 'Combined with a high-capacity battery and automatic charging, the system enables 24/7 continuous operation. With a maintenance-friendly design that minimizes downtime — such as battery replacement'. IMPORTANT: max_payload is NOT published for the P300 anywhere I could find (unlike the B150/B300/B600, whose payload is in the prose). Left NULL — do NOT infer '300 kg' from the model number: the card says only 'For Integration', and one data point (P200 = 200 kg) is not enough to establish that P-series numbers are payload codes. max_speed, gradient, temperature, humidity, IP and turning data are likewise not published for this model.

Cost-optimised integration platform. Card: 'For Integration / 8 h Run Time / 780*550*290 mm / I/O, Ethernet, WLAN, Power'. max_payload=150 from the prose: 'With a 150kg payload, the mobile robot platform Youibot B150 seamlessly blends high load capacity with unparalleled flexibility'. infrastructure_free=true from 'Compared to traditional AGV solutions, with our autonomous mobile robots you can enjoy automatic map updates without the need for scene modifications'. max_fleet_size=200 from 'The system's real-time scheduling capability can handle up to 200 robots in the same scenario'. autonomous_charging + battery_swap_capable from 'Each robot is equipped for automatic charging, manual charging, and maintenance battery exchange, ensuring non-stop 24/7 operation'. top_module_type from 'rollers, belts, synchronous belt transfers, and backpack-style racks'. SAFETY NOTE: the B-series description states 'The front hosts a centrally positioned, high-quality laser measurement radar with a 260 deg scanning range. And rear-point laser sensors support deceleration zones, stop zones, and emergency stop zones' — that is a 260 deg front scanner plus rear point sensors, NOT the dual-lidar full 360 deg safety-rated layout of the L1000/P200, so safety_coverage is left NULL rather than asserted as 'Single plane (2D)'. No speed, battery chemistry/capacity, charge time, temperature, humidity, IP, gradient or turning data published.

Identical chassis and identical marketing text to the B150 but rated 300 kg: 'With a 300kg payload, the mobile robot platform Youibot B300 seamlessly blends high load capacity with unparalleled flexibility'. Card: 'For Integration / 8 h Run Time / 780*550*290 mm / I/O, Ethernet, WLAN, Power'. Same sourcing, same caveats and same NULLs as the B150 entry (incl. safety_coverage left NULL because of the 260 deg front scanner layout). Note the B150 and B300 share the same 780*550*290 mm envelope — the difference is the drive/structure rating, not the footprint.

Heavy integration platform on the large chassis (1150*770*300 mm — essentially the same footprint as the L1000-CE/L1500). Card: 'For Integration / 8 h Run Time / 1150*770*300 mm / I/O, Ethernet, WLAN, Power'. max_payload=600 from '600kg Payload Capacity with Superior Strength and Flexibility' and 'The Youibot B600 redefines high-capacity logistics with its robust 600kg payload'. max_fleet_size=200 from 'Capable of coordinating up to 200 robots in a single environment'. battery_swap_capable=true from 'Each robot supports autonomous charging, manual charging, and hot-swappable battery options'. SAFETY NOTE: the B600 text says 'multi-level safety inputs and 180 deg front-rear safety bumper coverage' plus 'a high-precision LiDAR offering wide-angle scanning' at the front and rear laser sensors — explicitly NOT described as 360 deg safety-rated scanning, so safety_coverage is left NULL. No speed, battery detail, charge time, environmental or gradient data published.

Single-station roller-conveyor AMR for automatic transfer to/from production-line conveyors. Card: 'Feature: Made-to-order / 8 h Run Time / 780*653*932 mm / I/O, Ethernet, WLAN, Power'. The 932 mm is the overall height including the roller deck. MAX_PAYLOAD IS NOT PUBLISHED for the C series anywhere — deliberately left NULL (the card literally prints 'Made-to-order' where the other series print a payload). station_applications=['Conveyor','Machine cell'] from 'The C-series roller robots interface seamlessly with production lines via roller/belt conveyors' and 'They support upstream/downstream equipment docking'. infrastructure_free=true from 'The C-series robots adapt to varying line layouts without facility modifications'. integration_capability from 'integrate with MES/WMS for task dispatching, storage monitoring, and real-time status feedback'. Safety text mentions 'laser scanners, photoelectric sensors, anti-collision mechanisms, and drop-prevention detectors ... 360 deg full-perimeter awareness' but does not state which of these are safety-rated, so safety_coverage is NULL. Confidence 'low' overall because this is a made-to-order product with almost no published numeric spec.

Dual-layer / dual-station roller-conveyor AMR. Card: 'Feature: Made-to-order / 8 h Run Time / 854*686*1487 mm'. multi_load_compatibility=true is well supported: 'Dual-layer synchronous roller robot that doubles vertical transfer throughput', 'Dual-station operation for end-to-end line boost', 'the dual-station model enables simultaneous loading and unloading of upper and lower carriers'. onboard_container_count deliberately NOT set to 2 — the two stations are conveyor decks, not container slots, and the AP0 field is about onboard containers. max_payload not published (made-to-order). Same NULLs and same reasoning as the C101 entry.

Operator-assisted order-picking trolley AMR — Youibot's only fulfilment-oriented model. Card: '100 kg Payload Capacity / 8 h Run Time / 650*550*1450 mm / Up to 500 Units Fleet Size'. safety_standard=['ISO 3691-4'] is HIGH confidence here and this is the ONLY Youibot product where the standard is named explicitly: 'CE ISO 3691-4 and ANSI/RIA 15.08 Compliance' (dedicated article: https://en.youibot.com/news/ensuring-safety-and-efficiency-with-the-ce-iso-3691-4-and-ansiria-1508-compliance-of-the-automatic-trolley-at100.html) and 'This CE and ANSI/RIA compliant product guarantees absolute safety for client's operation'. NOTE: ANSI/RIA R15.08 is the industrial-mobile-robot standard and is NOT the same as the AP0 allowed value 'ANSI/ITSDF B56.5' — I deliberately did NOT map it, to avoid a false categorical match. max_fleet_size=500 from the official card. infrastructure_free=true from 'zero infrastructure changes'. workflow_capability includes 'Picking support': 'an order-picking robot. An assisted picking robot is the centerpiece of the e-commerce warehouse automation and assisted picking solution, increasing retailers' order picking rates by 3x and achieving 99.9% picking accuracy'; 'It supports a range of different workflows, including picking, returning, replenishment, and P2P transfer'. picking_mechanism='Human-assisted (cart follower)' is LOW confidence — it is the closest AP0 value for an operator-assisted picking trolley, but Youibot never describes it as person-following; set this field NULL if the operator prefers strict citation. throughput_picks_per_hour NOT recorded: the '3x picking rate' and '99.9 % accuracy' claims are relative/quality figures, not an absolute picks-per-hour number. CONFLICT: the IPROS Japan listing gives 640*630*1615 mm, 127 kg body weight, 1.5 m/s rated speed, 180 deg/s rotation, 820 mm rotation diameter and 1.5 h full recharge for the AT100 — I used the OFFICIAL 650*550*1450 mm and left max_speed / charge_time / min_turning_radius NULL, because the two dimension sets disagree and that undermines trust in the rest of that listing for this model.
